item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 20/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be cloudy over the coast of southern China on Lunar New Year's Eve and Lunar New Year's Day. The northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong at night on the second day of the Lunar New Year. It will become cold and windier over the region in the following couple of days.

Date/Month: 21/01 (Saturday)
Wind: East force 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two light rain patches.
Temp range: 16 - 19 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 22/01 (Sunday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4, force 5 at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Bright periods during the day. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 18 - 21 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
